_doc: v2 brief - see docs/art/CITY_TILESET_SYSTEM.md for the full rationale. Walls are now SEAMLESS-TILED (materials[].wall_prompt, generated with circular-padding conv layers, sliced into N segments) instead of independently-generated 'single object' chunks, which the first pass proved don't connect. Corners/end-caps/windows stay bounded single objects (that part of the first pass worked) but reuse each material's own color/texture words so they visually match their wall.
